chunks: We gave Moses the Book, and made his brother Aaron his minister,
ai.seo_question: Who was appointed as the minister to Prophet Moses in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Furqan, this verse underscores the divine institution of prophetic leadership by pairing Moses (AS) with Aaron (AS) as a supportive vizier, a model often cited in Shia scholarship to illustrate the concept of auxiliary authority (wilayah) within the prophetic mission. The term 'waziran' highlights not just administrative support but a spiritual and structural partnership that facilitated the delivery of the Torah and the management of the Israelites. This collaboration serves as a precedent for the cooperative dynamic seen later between the Imams and their deputies or among the Ahl al-Bayt themselves.
